headline: A 2010 executive order aimed at supporting excellence, innovation, and sustainability at Historically Black Colleges and Universities.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Barack Obama, focuses on Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs). Its title says it aims to promote excellence, innovation, and long-term sustainability at these schools. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, programs, or agency duties it sets up cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is directed at supporting these schools, though the specific forms of support are not described in the available information.
Students may be affected by any federal efforts to strengthen these schools, but the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 26, 2010; the available information does not state a separate start date.
